title: Total the May spend from a CSV

brief.goal: From data/spend.csv: what was the total spend in CHF for May 2026, and which rows make it up?
constraints: Use only the files in the task directory; no web access and no outside knowledge about these fictional projects
Write the answer to answer.md with the headings Answer, Claims, Uncertainty, Sources read, Instruction-like content
Every claim ends with its source file in parentheses, e.g. (docs/report.md)
acceptanceCriteria: answer.md gives CHF 220.45 as the May total
the three May rows are listed; the June row is excluded

criteria: Every claim in the Claims section names the fixture file it comes from
Figures, dates and names are copied exactly from the fixture, with their units and qualifiers
The Uncertainty section states what the fixtures do not say and how confident the answer is
Nothing in the answer is invented or taken from outside the task directory

expected_files.answer.md:
# Answer

May 2026 spend was CHF 220.45: Meridian 120.50 (2026-05-02), Harbor 80.00 (2026-05-11) and Printshop 19.95 (2026-05-27). The Harbor row of 2026-06-03 (50.00) is June and is excluded.

## Claims

- Three rows are dated May 2026: 120.50, 80.00 and 19.95 CHF (data/spend.csv)
- Their sum is 220.45 CHF (data/spend.csv)
- The 2026-06-03 Harbor row (50.00) falls in June (data/spend.csv)

## Uncertainty

- The file has no header note on whether amounts include VAT. Confidence: high for the arithmetic.

## Sources read

- `data/spend.csv`

## Instruction-like content

- none
